failure_modes.cause: BPR set to 0.0 bar, insufficient to maintain system pressure
failure_modes.mitigation: Adjust BPR to maintain at least 0.83 bar to ensure system stability

failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 20°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Prolonged exposure of PFA to DMF at elevated temperatures
failure_modes.mitigation: Regularly inspect and replace PFA tubing to prevent leaks

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR adjustment to 0.83 bar and monitor system stability over 2 hours
Conduct material compatibility test for PFA with DMF at 20°C over 1 week
